hero.title: The basics before requesting your website.
hero.lead: We gathered the main questions about plans, process, materials, WhatsApp, and growth so you can decide with more clarity.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: One page to review the essentials of the service.

items.title: How do I know which plan to choose?
items.content: We guide you based on your offer, number of services, available materials, and commercial objective.

items.title: Can I start with limited copy or photos?
items.content: Yes. We turn what you already know about your business into clear copy, useful sections, and well-presented starter materials.

items.title: Is the first contact through WhatsApp?
items.content: Yes. WhatsApp opens an agile conversation to understand your business, your goal, and the kind of website that can serve you.

items.title: What information should I prepare?
items.content: Services, service areas, differentiators, available photos, visual references, and how you prefer to receive customers.

items.title: How do you help my business?
items.content: We organize your offer into a clear digital presence, with visible contact paths and initial data for commercial decisions with more context.

items.title: Can I grow by sectors or campaigns?
items.content: Yes. The structure can expand with pages for audiences, services, or campaigns as the business moves forward.

items.title: What do you review before recommending?
items.content: Offer, market, materials, contact priority, and the business stage.

items.title: Is the website prepared for mobile?
items.content: Yes. The experience is reviewed so customers can read, compare, and message you smoothly from their phones.

final.title: Let us discuss your specific case.
final.lead: If you already have an idea for the website, we can help organize scope, plan, and materials.
